heading: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for September 21, 2026
author: Samir Jain / TOI Astrology /  Sep 21, 2026, 00:00 IST
paragraphs: Aries:Today, the Moon will bring you joy, and you may find yourself being kind to the people around you
With the support of your family members, you may be able to make some difficult business decisions
Your communication skills could help you secure a major order, boosting your business.Taurus:You are blessed by the Moon today and may feel stronger from within
You may enjoy your time at work and share passionate moments with your spouse, improving harmony at home
You might come up with fresh ideas for a new venture, and your perfectionist approach may help you execute your plans successfully
Lovebirds should avoid meaningless conversations.Gemini:You could feel disappointed today
Try to control your arrogance while speaking with others, or harsh words may lead to losses
Lovebirds should be careful during conversations, as arguments over trivial matters could affect their relationships.Cancer:You may experience peace of mind today
You could plan to invest money in your business, which may improve liquidity and increase your bank balance
Romantic moments with your partner may strengthen family harmony
Singles may find a suitable match, while lovebirds may decide to get married.Leo:You may feel quite joyful today, and past losses could turn into gains
Your boss may appreciate your work and be pleased with your performance
You may experience changes in your work location or position, possibly in connection with a promotion
You may also be able to overcome challenges posed by opponents and hidden rivals
Lovebirds may make important marriage decisions with the support of relatives or friends.Virgo:The Moon is favourable today, and you may enjoy good health
You may plan a visit to a religious place with family or friends
You could also consider donating money to a religious institution or charity
Property deals that were pending may be completed
You may have the opportunity to travel abroad for business or begin planning for further education.Libra:The Moon may bring some challenges today
You could find yourself caught up in misunderstandings or conspiracies, so it is best to avoid unnecessary debates
Your strong willpower and the support of elders may help you navigate difficult situations
You are also advised to avoid speeding or risky adventure trips.Scorpio:You may be busy at work today and feel excited about your projects
You may make quick decisions that benefit your business
You might also launch a new venture or innovation with a partner
However, investing in fixed assets through a partnership is not advised today.Sagittarius:You may perform well at work today and could see opportunities for a promotion or a beneficial transfer
The Moon is favourable, and you may also be considering a change in your current job
You are likely to maintain good relationships with elders
Long-standing health concerns may begin to improve.Capricorn:You are blessed by the Moon today
Things may remain under control, and you may enjoy your work with better concentration
Your improved focus could positively influence your approach to work
Your wisdom may help you make challenging career decisions
Earlier investments may bring in profits.Aquarius:You may feel bored and dissatisfied today
You could struggle to enjoy the day and may find yourself dealing with pride or overconfidence
This could affect both your professional and domestic life
You may also experience a lack of confidence, which could hold you back from exploring creative ideas at work.Pisces:You may feel energetic today and perform efficiently at work
Your hard work could begin to pay off, boosting your confidence
Property-related disputes with siblings may be resolved
You may meet an important person who could expand your professional network
Disagreements with your partner may also come to an end.Get the latest astrology news and horoscope updates
